_note: slug -> the model. Run names carry the slug, so a slug means the same model whichever API serves it. Default API is OpenRouter (key file and proxy: harness/llm.py). A model with "api" goes to that entry of _apis and needs "price" (USD per million tokens: input, cached input, output) for spend to be counted. `cache: explicit` marks the prompt for caching on OpenRouter (Anthropic models cache only what is marked). Optional: max_usd (per run), max_tokens, reasoning, provider, temperature, context. Check ids and prices: python3 harness/bench.py check. Another file can be used with FDEGYM_MODELS=<path>. Routing that belongs to one machine (another API's address, key file paths) goes in a copy outside version control, used with FDEGYM_MODELS.
